papers.title_en: Timing Matters Twice: When to Query and When to Skip in Flow-Matching On-Policy Distillation
papers.authors: Renye Yan, Junyi Zhan, Jikang Cheng, Wei Peng
papers.evidence: 流匹配在线策略蒸馏的时机选择
papers.tldr: 在流匹配在线策略蒸馏中，不同评价维度与任务对去噪阶段的监督需求不同，预定义时间步采样易错失有效阶段并带来冗余计算。PhaseOPD利用学生速度预测在线识别生成阶段，按教师阶段偏好自适应查询，并在查询确定后跳过剩余rollout。在SD3.5-M上每局部批次仅执行16个rollout位置中的5.56个，训练时间较DanceOPD降低41.3%，同时提升Aesthetic、GenEval和OCR。该工作将“何时查询”与“何时跳过”统一为阶段感知的时序决策，提升蒸馏效率与效果。
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables flow-matching models to acquire complementary capabilities from specialized teachers through supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, different evaluation dimensions, such as aesthetics and OCR accuracy, and different tasks, such as image generation and editing, emphasize different aspects of the denoising process, suggesting that their effective supervision may occur at different stages. Existing methods typically select supervision states from predefined timestep distributions, which may overlook these phase-dependent differences and incur unnecessary computational overhead. This motivates two critical timing decisions: when to adaptively query teachers for effective supervision based on the evolving generative process, and when to skip the remaining rollout to avoid redundant computation.   In this paper, we introduce PhaseOPD, a phase-aware query-and-skip framework that identifies generative phases online from revisions of predicted-clean latents, using existing student velocity predictions without additional model evaluations. For each task-assigned teacher, PhaseOPD selects a supervision state based on its phase preference and skips the unused rollout suffix once all query decisions are finalized, preserving the single-query velocity-distillation objective. On SD3.5-M, PhaseOPD executes only 5.56 of 16 rollout positions per local batch, reducing training time by 41.3% relative to DanceOPD while improving Aesthetic, GenEval, and OCR scores.

papers.authors: Arnav Chavan, Chanhyuk Lee, Udbhav Bamba, Jaehoon Yoo, Seunghoon Hong, Aditi Raghunathan, Jinwoo Kim
papers.evidence: 十亿规模流匹配生成模型
papers.tldr: 连续流语言模型具备并行生成潜力，但十亿参数级构建方法仍不成熟。Lafa采用分块流设计，前缀因果注意力、块内双向异步流，可从预训练自回归模型高效适配，并利用前缀缓存和块并行解码加速。在0.5B、7B、8B规模上用少于300亿token训练，指令跟随、推理和编码质量匹配或超越AR，且可通过自推测解码达到约2.54倍吞吐。该工作表明连续流可作为可扩展的语言建模基础。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.

papers.title_en: PixGR: Pixel-Space Generative Decoding for Fast Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Ranran Huang, Wenjing Bian, Weixun Luo, Ye Mao, Krystian Mikolajczyk
papers.evidence: 像素空间流匹配生成式解码
papers.tldr: 稀疏视角下的前馈3D高斯重建易受场景不确定性影响，现有两阶段生成流程还受VAE潜空间压缩和误差传播制约。PixGR把轻量像素空间生成建模引入前馈重建：先将上下文观测编码为场景潜表示，再用像素空间flow matching条件化解码含噪目标视图，生成共享3D高斯，并通过可微渲染实现端到端监督。实验表明，该方法在稀疏观测与视角外推下优于回归方法，同时保持亚秒级推理，性能可媲美更重的预训练生成模型。
papers.abstract_en: We present PixGR, an efficient framework that integrates lightweight pixel-space generative modeling into feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction to model scene uncertainty. Context observations are encoded once into a scene latent representation, which conditions generative decoding from noisy target views to produce a shared 3D Gaussian representation. We formulate this process using pixel-space flow matching, enabling end-to-end optimization of 3D reconstruction with direct pixel-space generative supervision through differentiable rendering. This avoids VAE-based latent compression and error propagation inherent in previous two-stage pipelines. To preserve feed-forward efficiency, PixGR caches the scene representation and performs iterative inference using a lightweight DiT decoder. Experiments demonstrate that PixGR outperforms regression-based approaches in challenging sparse-view settings, particularly with widely spaced observations and view extrapolation. Meanwhile, it maintains sub-second inference and remains competitive with substantially heavier pretrained generative models. Our project page is available at https://ranrhuang.github.io/pixgr/.

papers.title_en: H-GLow: Accelerating Graph Generation via Hazard-Guided Discrete Flow Matching
papers.evidence: 用于图生成的离散流匹配
papers.tldr: 图生成中的离散流匹配（DFM）虽可解耦训练与采样，但受节点—边强依赖影响，少步采样仍难且依赖任务启发式。H-GLow将连续时间马尔可夫链生成器分解为风险与条件跳跃分布，用其规划图编辑并按图活跃度动态调整采样时间。方法可适配预训练图DFM，并提出直接预测风险与条件跳跃的条件生成器匹配模型。分子与合成图实验显示，在显著更少采样步数下生成质量提升。
papers.abstract_en: Discrete flow matching (DFM) offers a promising approach to graph generation; however, generating high-quality graphs with few steps remains challenging due to the strong dependencies between nodes and edges. Although DFM decouples training from sampling, enabling flexible sampling strategies without retraining, existing graph DFM samplers often rely on task-specific heuristics, substantially expanding the hyperparameter space. Moreover, graph DFM models still require sampling budgets comparable to those of diffusion-based approaches, leaving their potential for accelerating graph generation only partially realized. In this work, we introduce H-Glow, a hazard-guided framework for accelerating graph generation built on the decomposition of Continuous-Time Markov chain (CTMC) generators into hazards and conditional jump distributions. H-Glow leverages these quantities to plan graph edits and dynamically adjust the sampling time to graph activity. H-Glow can be adapted to pretrained graph DFM models, substantially improving the generation quality with fewer steps. We further introduce a novel graph DFM model based on the conditional generator matching framework, which directly predicts hazards and conditional jumps, and show that its training objective decomposes exactly into hazard matching and hazard-weighted jump prediction. Experiments on molecular and synthetic graph benchmarks demonstrate improved generation quality with substantially fewer sampling steps.

papers.title_en: Transporting Quantiles to Codebook: Scalable Vector Quantization without Codebook Collapse
papers.evidence: 用量化中的轻量流匹配模型学习潜空间
papers.tldr: VQ-VAE 是自回归生成模型的关键离散表示组件，但常出现码本坍缩与码字利用率低。FlowVQ 将神经量化视为联合建模与聚类，用轻量 flow matching 学习潜空间，并通过概率流 ODE 将等分位先验码从源分布传输到码本。方法在诱导分布下取 Voronoi 质心，形成结构化离散化。图像 tokenization/生成及高精度 tokenization 任务显示其可扩展、码本表达更强且利用充分。
papers.abstract_en: Effective discrete representation learning with VQ-VAE serves as a fundamental component of modern autoregressive generative models. However, it is widely known to suffer from codebook collapse and inefficient code utilization. To address this issue, we propose FlowVQ, a simple yet effective alternative to standard vector quantization by formulating neural quantization as a joint modeling and clustering process. Specifically, we learn the latent space using a lightweight flow matching model alongside training, corresponding to a probability flow ODE that transports an often fixed well-behaved source distribution while preserving probability mass. Based on this, we define the codebook C_1 by transporting even-quantile partitioned prior codes C_0 from the source space through the learned flow, and obtaining the Voronoi centroids under the induced distribution, leading to a structured discretization. We evaluated on image tokenization and generation, as well as on two tasks requiring high-precision tokenization, demonstrating scalability and improved expressivity of the codebook with full utilization.
